definition.label: a cellar room
definition.notice: CELLAR ROOM TO LET. Dry enough. A straw bed and a crate.
definition.night: You sleep on the straw in your cellar, your own door bolted. Damp, but nobody snores but you.

definition.label: a garret room
definition.notice: GARRET TO LET under the roof. A plank bed. Light from the dormer window.
definition.night: You sleep in your garret under the tiles. The wind walks on the roof, but the door is yours.

definition.label: a room at a widow's
definition.notice: A CLEAN ROOM TO LET to a quiet single man. Bed and linen. Coffee in the morning. Ask the widow.
definition.night: You sleep between the widow's linen sheets. In the morning there is coffee and a heel of bread.

definition.label: a small house in an alley
definition.notice: HOUSE TO LET in the alley. One room down, a box bed, its own hearth.
definition.night: You sleep in the box bed of your own house, the hearth's last embers ticking. The alley is quiet.

definition.label: a merchant's upper floor
definition.notice: FIRST FLOOR TO LET over the counting house. Two tall windows on the river, a marble fireplace, a bed in an alcove, furnished.
definition.night: You sleep in the alcove bed on the first floor, the fire ticking as it dies. Ships' lights move on the ceiling.

table.name: a deal table
table.note: Scrubbed pine, rings from other men's pots.

rug.name: a rag rug
rug.note: Woven from old coats. Keeps the cold off the floor.

stove.name: a cast-iron stove
stove.note: A little pot-bellied stove, pipe included. Heavy.

plant.name: a geranium in a pot
plant.note: Red, a bit leggy. Wants the light.

birdcage.name: a finch in a cage
birdcage.note: A chaffinch in a wicker cage on a stand. It sings at dawn.

picture.name: a framed print
picture.note: The cathedral spire in a black frame. Hang it on a wall.

lamp.name: a hanging oil lamp
lamp.note: Brass font, glass chimney. Hang it from a beam.

clock.name: a wall clock
clock.note: A Black Forest clock. It ticks; the hour is the town's.

curtains.name: a pair of curtains
curtains.note: Faded red wool. For a window.
